_note: Patch-resolution vectors. Category patch_apply: raw_input is {file_content, old_str, new_str}; the rule (from SmallCode's patch tool in bin/executor.js) is that old_str must match exactly one location — expected.result_content on success, expected_outcome no_match / ambiguous / validation_error otherwise (SmallCode's model-driven semantic-merge fallback on no_match is NOT ported; Legion surfaces the failure for re-read). Categories search_replace_block and diff_fence: raw_input is model-emitted edit-block text; expected.edits lists parsed {path?, old_str, new_str} edits, expected_outcome unrepairable for malformed blocks. These block formats do not exist in SmallCode (its patch is tool-argument based), so those records are synthetic. In Legion all resulting edits feed TextEditProposal / WorkspaceEditProposalPayload — nothing writes directly.

name: patch_insertion_via_context
note: Insertion is expressed as replacing an anchor line with itself plus the new line.

name: patch_old_str_not_found
note: SmallCode falls back to a model-driven semantic merge here; the deterministic Legion port must fail and require a re-read instead.

name: patch_ambiguous_two_matches
note: old_str matches 2 locations; caller must include more context.

name: patch_non_string_arg
note: A numeric new_str is rejected, not coerced.

name: patch_whitespace_drift_no_match
note: Matching is exact: tab vs four-space indentation does not match.

name: patch_crlf_vs_lf_no_match
note: Matching is exact bytes: LF old_str does not match a CRLF file.

name: patch_identical_old_new_noop
note: Unique match with identical replacement succeeds as a no-op.

name: search_replace_single_block
search_replace_two_blocks
search_replace_missing_divider
note: No ======= divider: the block cannot be split into search and replace halves.

name: search_replace_truncated_block
note: Missing >>>>>>> REPLACE terminator: likely a truncated response; must not be applied.

name: search_replace_empty_search_creates_file
raw_input:
src/new_module.rs
<<<<<<< SEARCH
=======
pub fn hello() {}
>>>>>>> REPLACE
note: Empty SEARCH half means create-file / full-content semantics.

name: diff_fence_single_hunk
raw_input:
```diff
--- a/src/config.rs
+++ b/src/config.rs
@@ -1,3 +1,3 @@
 line1
-old line
+new line
 line3
```
note: A unified-diff hunk reduces to an exact-match edit: context+removed lines as old_str, context+added lines as new_str.

name: diff_fence_truncated_hunk
note: Fence never closes and the hunk is cut mid-line; must not be applied.
